Russian forces continued offensive operations in northern Sumy Oblast on October 15 and 16 but did not make confirmed advances.

Russian forces continued offensive operations in northern Kharkiv Oblast on October 15 and 16 but did not make confirmed advances as Ukrainian forces counterattacked near Starytsya (northeast of Kharkiv City).

Gerasimov also credited elements of the Russian 110th Motorized Rifle Brigade, 114th Motorized Rifle Brigade, and 5th Separate Motorized Rifle Brigade (all 51st Combined Arms Army [CAA], formerly 1st Donetsk People’s Republic Army Corps [DNR AC], SMD), 61st Separate Naval Infantry Brigade (Northern Fleet), and 177th Separate Naval Infantry Regiment (Caspian Flotilla) with the claimed seizure of Dobropillya. Gerasimov also claimed that Russian forces seized Pervomaiske and Serhiivka (north and southwest of Dobropillya respectively) and entered Bilozerke (southwest of Pervomaiske). ISW has not observed any evidence to suggest that Russian forces have advanced north of or into Dobropillya beyo
